findings.title: Rejected SHUTDOWN clears the managed qualification intake fence
findings.trigger: An original managed qualification Run remains QUEUED/unsettled; EndLocalQualificationWindow correctly leaves qualificationActive and intakeClosed true. Request SHUTDOWN.
findings.observed: QuiesceForRelease rejects the unresolved Run but sets intakeClosed false. Subsequent Scan returns early because qualificationActive is still true, so it does not restore intake closure.
findings.impact: The session admission guard now reports open while the original qualification remains unresolved, violating the required continuous session intake fence. This does not demonstrate a second MODEL dispatch; Scan itself stays fenced.
findings.recommendation: Preserve the previous intake fence on all failed drain paths and release abort; compose shutdown state with active/durable qualification state. Add a regression for rejected SHUTDOWN followed by Scan and session admission.

findings.title: Coordinator startup exposes intake before restoring durable or managed-startup fence
findings.trigger: Construct a real coordinator over an existing consumed qualification with an unresolved Run; alternatively construct it with ManagedStartupHold=true.
findings.observed: The constructor returns with the zero-valued intakeClosed=false. Durable qualification closure occurs only inside a later Scan. ManagedStartupHold returns before that restoration and leaves intake open even after Scan.
findings.impact: Startup has an admission window for client session mutations despite unresolved qualification state; the managed startup branch retains open intake until BeginLocalQualificationWindow. Existing Scan dispatch suppression does not fulfill session intake closure.
findings.recommendation: Initialize intake closed synchronously before exposing the coordinator, restore/check durable qualification state and ManagedStartupHold under the startup lease, and open only after validated recovery. Cover constructor return, first Scan, and client admission.
